manuscript: Codex Washingtonianus (GA 032), Freer Gallery of Art F1906.274
method: CSNTM imageId/imageName table read from the viewer page; Freer ids probed on ids.si.edu; each Freer thumbnail matched to the CSNTM thumbnail with the highest normalised pixel correlation (32x48 greyscale); accepted only if score >= 0.995 and margin over runner-up >= 0.03
